findings.summary: Lean proves the properties only for the stage states of the fixed cycle iteration, with concrete exponents 1/2+σ_j and 1+σ_j, not for an arbitrary finite sequence of the listed operations with abstract exponents α, μ.

The zero-extension clause for mean coefficients is stated elsewhere: E_θ, E_z, g_r and the reconstructed p_m are MovingFields (smooth at all radii, vanishing outside the closed shell). The auditor missed these; only the flat alias part lacks it.
(9.5) is not one physical-norm theorem. Lean gives chart-native bounds with arbitrary gain h·α for the base, Gaussian and alias errors separately, on the lifted open shell for bands n ≥ 4.

Lean's R = G + F is a chart identity on the lifted strip. The physical form goes through a bridge whose realization hypotheses are discharged in the repository for every stage, not left external as the auditor said.

The label-sum decomposition (9.4) and the mean identity (9.6) are Lean statements only on the lifted open active shell; the paper states them on the whole chart. Exterior and shell edges are handled by separate statements.
